# WorkSafeBC

> WorkSafeBC is British Columbia's workers' compensation and occupational health & safety authority, providing comprehensive coverage, claims management, safety guidance, and regulatory compliance resources for employers and workers.

WorkSafeBC administers workers' compensation insurance, enforces occupational health and safety regulations, and offers industry-specific guidance across all sectors in British Columbia. The organization serves as the primary resource for workplace injury prevention, claims processing, and employer compliance.

## Key Topics

- Workers' Compensation
- Occupational Health & Safety
- Workplace Injury Reporting
- Insurance Coverage & Premiums
- Claims Management
- Return to Work Programs
- OHS Regulation Compliance
- Hazard Prevention
- Employer Responsibilities
- Worker Protection
- Risk Management
- Workplace Certification
- Contractor Clearance
- Industry-Specific Safety
- Chemical Exposures

## Core Services

- [WorkSafeBC Homepage](https://www.worksafebc.com/en): WorkSafeBC homepage covering health & safety, claims, insurance, and policy
- [Claims](https://www.worksafebc.com/en/claims): WorkSafeBC claims overview, injury reporting, benefits, and return to work
- [Insurance](https://www.worksafebc.com/en/insurance): WorkSafeBC insurance coverage, premiums, rates, and account management
- [Health & Safety](https://www.worksafebc.com/en/health-safety): WorkSafeBC Health & Safety hub with industry-specific guidance and resources

## Claims & Return to Work

- [Report a Workplace Injury or Disease](https://www.worksafebc.com/en/claims/report-workplace-injury-illness): WorkSafeBC guide to reporting workplace injuries and starting a claim

## Insurance & Coverage

- [Apply for Coverage](https://www.worksafebc.com/en/insurance/apply-for-coverage): WorkSafeBC insurance application process and employer registration guide
- [Manage Your Account](https://www.worksafebc.com/en/insurance/manage-account): WorkSafeBC account management, payroll reporting, and premium payments
- [Need Coverage?](https://www.worksafebc.com/en/insurance/need-coverage): WorkSafeBC guide to insurance coverage needs and registration requirements
- [Know How Much Coverage Costs](https://www.worksafebc.com/en/insurance/know-coverage-costs): WorkSafeBC guide to coverage costs, premiums, and classification units
- [Why Do I Need a Clearance Letter?](https://www.worksafebc.com/en/insurance/why-clearance-letter): WorkSafeBC clearance letter requirements and contractor liability protection

## Occupational Health & Safety Guidance

- [Create & Manage a Healthy & Safe Workplace](https://www.worksafebc.com/en/health-safety/create-manage): WorkSafeBC guide to creating and managing healthy safe workplaces
- [Hazards & Exposures](https://www.worksafebc.com/en/health-safety/hazards-exposures): WorkSafeBC reference on workplace hazards, chemical exposures, and limits
- [Injuries & Diseases](https://www.worksafebc.com/en/health-safety/injuries-diseases): WorkSafeBC resource on workplace injuries, occupational diseases, prevention
- [Education, Training & Certification](https://www.worksafebc.com/en/health-safety/education-training-certification): WorkSafeBC training, certification programs, and regulatory requirements
- [Tools, Machinery & Equipment](https://www.worksafebc.com/en/health-safety/tools-machinery-equipment): WorkSafeBC guidance on tools, machinery, equipment safety and compliance
